prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / precise-object-edit. Generate a NEW, isolated high-quality 2D modeling reference of ONE detachable character component. Image 1 is the APPROVED Tripothon B explorer turnaround; image 2 supplements fine details from the old front reference. The approved identity, medium stylized proportions and costume design must be kept. Recreate the requested component independently; do not merely crop the old image, do not show the complete character. Single object, single specified view, centered and large with generous clear margin, orthographic or very mild orthographic three-quarter view as specified, soft neutral studio lighting, solid white background, negligible contact shadow. Polished smooth stylized 3D illustration, clean silhouette and coherent volume. No environment, props, captions, labels, borders, extra copies, scale rulers or invented ornaments. Full component must fit in frame. This is a modeling REFERENCE, not a posed final character or rigged mesh.
Isolate ONE RIGHT HAND of approved explorer, rendered in the same softly stylized warm light skin. DORSAL/back-of-hand view, fingers pointing upward, wrist stump at bottom, thumb on viewer's LEFT. Exactly five fingers total: thumb plus index/middle/ring/little, correct differing lengths, three softly articulated phalanges per long finger, realistic but stylized palm proportions, smooth natural knuckles and nails, gentle small gaps between all fingers, no fused fingers. Open relaxed neutral hand, not spread excessively, no clenched fist. No arm, sleeve, rings or gloves. High-quality hand surface, not low-poly. Orthographic view centered, only one hand.
